items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I am very pleased to have pianist Harold Mabern with me today... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you.

ctx.x: I look forward to your concert tonight.
Thank you Mr. Monk Rowe, well my pleasure. © Fillius Jazz Archive -27-
